item.title: Atlantic Tropical Weather Outlook
item.description:
000
ABNT20 KNHC 111129
TWOAT

Tropical Weather Outlook
NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL
800 AM EDT Sun Oct 11 2026

For the North Atlantic...Caribbean Sea and the Gulf of America:

Active Systems:
The Weather Prediction Center is issuing advisories on Post-Tropical
Cyclone Isaias, located near the border of Tennessee and Kentucky.

Eastern Tropical Atlantic:
An elongated area of low pressure centered a few hundred miles
southwest of the Cabo Verde Islands is producing a large but
disorganized area of showers and thunderstorms extending from these
islands southward into the eastern Tropical Atlantic. Environmental
conditions appear only marginally conducive for some development of
this system over the next day or two before upper-level winds become
too strong for development by midweek. Regardless of development,
heavy rainfall will be possible during the next few days over
portions of the Cabo Verde Islands as the system moves slowly
northward to north-northwestward.
* Formation chance through 48 hours...low...20 percent.
* Formation chance through 7 days...low...20 percent.

$$
Forecaster Papin

item.title: Summary for Post-Tropical Cyclone Isaias (AT4/AL092026)
item.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
item.description: ...FLASH FLOOD THREAT FROM ISAIAS IS DECREASING BUT SOME RISK CONTINUES TODAY ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE APPALACHIANS AND MID-ATLANTIC... As of 11:00 AM EDT Sun Oct 11 the center of Isaias was located near 37.5, -84.0 with movement ENE at 22 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1010 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 25 mph.

item.title: Post-Tropical Cyclone Isaias Public Advisory Number 20
item.description: The NHC has issued its final advisory on this system. Public Advisories from the Weather Prediction Center will provide updates as long as the system remains a flood threat. Issued at 1100 AM EDT Sun Oct 11 2026

item.title: Post-Tropical Cyclone Isaias Forecast Discussion Number 20
item.description:
Issued at 1100 AM EDT Sun Oct 11 2026 
000
WTNT44 KWNH 111500
TCDAT4
 
Post-Tropical Cyclone Isaias Discussion Number  20
NWS Weather Prediction Center College Park MD   AL092026
1100 AM EDT Sun Oct 11 2026
 
Key Messages:
 
1. Areas of heavy rainfall will continue across portions of the 
Central Appalachians and Mid-Atlantic today, with localized flash 
and urban flooding possible. River flooding continues in western 
North Carolina. 

2. Swells from Isaias will continue to affect much of the Gulf and
Southeastern Atlantic coasts of the United States today. These 
swells are likely to cause life-threatening surf and rip current 
conditions. Please consult products from your local weather office.
 
3. A couple of tornadoes are possible today across the Piedmont and
Coastal Plain of Virginia and North Carolina.
 
 
FORECAST POSITIONS AND MAX WINDS
